dosha.txt: Mangal Dosha present from Moon only. Mars is in the 6th from the lagna and the 12th from the Moon. Cancelling factors: Mars in own sign (Aries / Scorpio). Mangal Shanti remedies are traditionally advised, and Manglik status is matched before marriage.
No Kaal Sarp Dosha — the nodal axis does not enclose all planets.
The Sun is afflicted by a node or Saturn — perform ancestral (Pitru) propitiation.
Saturn is not currently transiting Sade Sati for this Moon sign.

yogas.txt: The 6th lord, Mars, is in the 6th house. Harsha Yoga, a Viparita Raja Yoga, brings happiness, health and victory over rivals.
Mars in the 12th from the Moon. Anapha Yoga brings good health, good character and renown.
Mercury in the 10th from the lagna or Moon. Amala Yoga brings a spotless reputation and lasting fame.
Mercury in the 2nd from the Sun. Vesi Yoga brings truthfulness and steady effort.
Moon and Venus are in each other's signs. Parivartana Yoga joins the houses they rule and strengthens both.
Jupiter and Sun; Jupiter and Venus join kendra and trikona lordship in one sign. Raja Yoga brings status, authority and success.

readings.lagna: Vrischika rising gives an intense, private and determined nature. You see beneath the surface and do not give up easily. Holding on to grievances is the quality to watch.
readings.moon: With the Moon in Vrishabha, where it is exalted, the mind is calm, steady and contented, with a love of comfort and beauty.
readings.nak: Rohini, ruled by the Moon, gives charm, creativity and a love of beauty and growth.
readings.dasha: Jupiter's Mahadasha brings growth, wisdom and good fortune, with focus on children, teachers, wealth and dharma.

planets.txt: The Sun in the 9th gives dharma, respect for father and teachers, and good fortune through principle.
The Moon in the 7th gives a caring, attractive partner and success in dealing with the public. Being exalted, it gives these results strongly.
Mars in the 6th is a strong placement that gives victory over rivals and obstacles. Being in its own sign, it gives these results strongly.
Mercury in the 10th gives a career in communication, commerce, writing or advising.
Jupiter in the 9th is among its best placements, giving fortune, dharma and wise teachers. Being exalted, it gives these results strongly.
Venus in the 9th gives good fortune, refined beliefs and comfort through travel.
Saturn in the 2nd gives slow but lasting wealth and reserved, careful speech. Being retrograde, its results come in an inward or delayed way.
Rahu in the 3rd is a strong placement that gives daring, enterprise and success through bold effort.
Ketu in the 9th gives a personal, spiritual path and detachment from orthodox belief.

transits.txt: Saturn transits your 5th house — a neutral, steady influence.
Jupiter transits your 10th house — a supportive, expansive period.
Rahu transits your 4th house — a neutral, steady influence.
